Start date: 1056-11-12  
Subtract 50 weeks = 50 × 7 = 350 days.  
Subtract 6 more days → total subtract 356 days.  
1056 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century year in Gregorian rules).  
Days in 1056 after Nov 12:  
Nov: 30 - 12 = 18 days left in Nov.  
Dec: 31 days → total 18 + 31 = 49 days left in 1056.  
356 - 49 = 307 days before 1056-11-12 go into 1055.  
1055 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in 1055 before Nov 12:  
From Jan 1 to Nov 12: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 30 + Oct 31 + Nov 12 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+12 = 316 days.  
307 days before Nov 12, 1055 = 316 - 307 = 9 days before Nov 12 → Nov 3, 1055.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1055-11-03
